terms: Free to use for academic purposes; cite Boteva et al. (2016). Other uses require source-author consultation. No redistribution of source texts in this repository.
representation: title.strip() + newline + text.strip(), then strip; source files unchanged

bm25.tokenizer: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric regex [a-z0-9]+; no stemming/stopwords; query terms unique

instruction: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
score: float32 yes-minus-no logit, descending; ascending document ID for ties
